text: Completed the P2.7 scenario/parity slice. S13 now consumes an independent R fmridesign + base-R lm.fit/full-covariance fixed-effects receipt; the public scenario uses semantic cell/basis hypotheses and type-safe result handling. External comparison exposed the known off-grid microtime convention boundary, so S13 deliberately uses exactly representable 0/4-second onsets to isolate mixed-TR/fixed-effects semantics rather than weakening tolerances. S08 now expresses unequal-score T/F trends through the public semantic DSL without ColumnId lookup, manual StructuralWeight rows, or unsafe casts. Manifest validation passes for 29 entries. Focused P2.7 JVM/JS suites pass 21/21 each, and tools/ci/first-level-gate.sh passes all JVM/JS HRF, design, model, fit, and scenario gates (design 223 JVM / 223 JS; fit 205 JVM / 197 JS in this run). git diff --check is clean for the slice.
